title: Stylish Townhouse, Rooftop Deck, Balcony, Wet Bar
description:
Stay GOODrich is a stylish four-bedroom Nashville townhouse with a rooftop deck, multiple balconies, city views, and a wet bar. The home sleeps eight with a king bed, two queen beds, and one bunk bed. Enjoy a full kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, washer and dryer, dedicated workspace, garage parking, and inviting outdoor seating for a comfortable group stay.

The space
With its open layout, fully furnished rooftop deck, and convenient top-floor wet bar, this four-bedroom townhouse is sure to be the highlight of your next Nashville vacation! Make your way into the heart of downtown for live music, incredible shopping, and fantastic restaurants, just four miles away, or check out a number of other local attractions including multiple wineries, distilleries, parks, and golf courses, many of which are less than 10 miles from your door.

Prepare all your favorite meals in the well-equipped, full kitchen with stainless steel appliances and counter seating for four and then head up to the deck for the perfect, open-air, alfresco experience. Back inside, stream your favorite channels in the living area before settling into one of four comfortable bedrooms found throughout the home including a kid-friendly bunkroom that opens right out to the deck.

With the addition of a private washer/dryer and central air-conditioning, you're sure to have a memorable stay here in the Music City!

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
